why: A widespread Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other services, prompting concerns about enterprise reliability and pressure on the shares. Traders are split between viewing the disruption as a serious hit to customer trust and treating it as a temporary setback and buying opportunity; cyberattack claims remain speculation, with Microsoft reporting no evidence of malicious activity.
